translation.name: Suha' Maseho: Kadadiam anna Pa'dandiam Bakahu

content: Pehapangam diona to balu-balu baine anna to mahhotto'
Puhai ia too, muala oom mesa pehapangam Puang Yesus umpa'guhu passikolanna naua: “La bassa' liukoa' ma'sambajam, anna tä'koa' la kattu hannu.
Aka hapanna illaam mesa kota deem mesa to mahhotto' tä' ungkahea' Puang Allataala anna umpa'pa'dei hupatau.
Illaam indo kota deem mesa to balu-balu baine pembudam sule umpellambi'i indo to mahhotto' nauaam: ‘Kela mala umpopataloä' lako indo balingku.’
Padam säena naolaam indo baine napelau anna malai napamoloi, sapo' moka liu indo to mahhotto'. Sapo' katampasanna napikki' naua: ‘Moi anna tä'ä' ungkahea' Puang Allataala anna umpa'pa'deiä' hupatau,
sapo' naganggu liuä' indo to balu-balu baine, iya dotam kupopatalo. Aka maka' tää', la sule liuä' nahahu'.’”
Puhai umpalao indo pehapangam, iya nauam Puang Yesus Debatanta: “Paillaam penaba manappaia' tula'na indo to mahhotto' tä' malolo!
Tä' daka tia duka' Puang Allataala la umpopatalo hupatau to napilei to tontä liu melau allo anna bengi? La napa'lembe-lembei haka tia umpamoloi tau ia too?
Kutulasangkoa', la masimpammi napopatalo tau ia too. Sapo' maka' sulemä' to disangai Änä' Mentolino, la deempaka to ungkatappa'iä' kulambi' illaam inde lino?”
Pehapangam diona to illaam kakalebuanna Parisi anna tuam passima
Napahuai duka' Puang Yesus pehapangam lako to ussanga kalena mapia gau' anna umpa'pa'de solana
naua: “Deem dua tau le'ba' lako Banua Debata la ma'sambajam. Mesa to illaam kakalebuanna Parisi anna mesa tuam passima.

Indo to illaam Parisi ke'de' anna ma'sambajanni illaam penabanna naua: ‘O Puang Allataala, ma'kuhhu' sumanga'ä' matim aka tä' kao susiä' tau senga' umpogau' ma'hupa-hupa kakadakeam susinna: muakkalanni aka-akanna solana anna malai naala, ma'gau' sengko', anna ullullu' pa'bannetauam. Anna tä' tooä' susi inde tuam passima.
Anna puasaä' penduam saminggu anna kubaba bahe sapulona pallolongangku kupehumalasam dio olomu.’
Sapo' indo ia tuam passima ke'de' mambela tukku-tukku napasindum umbusu'-busu' buana aka untihokongam gau' kadakena naua: ‘O Puang Allataala, kamaseiä' aka mesaä' to madosa.’”

Puhai umpalao indo pehapangam, iya nauam Puang Yesus: “Kutulasangkoa' tappana ma'pasule lako banuanna indo to illaam Parisi, tä' napomalolo Puang Allataala. Sapo' indo tuam passima, napomalolo ia Puang Allataala. Aka menna-menna ussanga-sanga kalena la napomadio Puang Allataala, sapo' menna-menna umpopengkadio kalena la napomatande ia Puang Allataala.”
Puang Yesus untamba' änä'-änä'
Pissam wattu sule sanaka-naka tau umbaba änä'-änä' bahinni'na lako Puang Yesus anna mala natamba'. Sapo' tappana naita passikolanna, iya ungkeaha'im indo tau.

Sapo' natambai Puang Yesus indo änä'-änä' mane ma'kadai lako passikolanna naua: “Päbäi mammi napellambi'iä' itim matim änä'-änä'. Daa ullabai, aka tau susim too itim matim la mendadi umma'na Puang Allataala illaam kapahentaanna.
Aka kutulasangkoa', setongam-tonganna, menna-menna tä' susi änä'-änä' untahima kapahentaanna Puang Allataala, tau ia too tä' la mendadi umma' petauanna.”
To makaka mapahhi' mendadi umma' illaam kapahentaanna Puang Allataala
Mesa pepungngu'na to Yahudi mekutana lako Puang Yesus naua: “O Tuangguhu to mapia gau', aka la kupogau' anna malaä' ullambi' katuboam sule lako salako-lakona?”
Natimba' naua: “Akanna muuaannä' to mapia gau'? Tä' deem mesa tau la mapia gau' sulibanna Puang Allataala.
Mannassa muissammi ingganna pahentana Puang Allataala naua: ‘Daa ullullu' pa'bannetauam, daa umpapateam, daa umpaboko, daa ussa'bi tatappa' diona padammu hupatau, pa'kasalleiko indomu sola ambemu.’”
Iya natimba'um indo tau naua: “Kutuhu'i asammi pahenta ia too mengkalao bahinni'ku.”

Tappana nahingngi Puang Yesus tula'na, iya nauaammi: “Deempi mesa tä' umpogau'. Balu' asanni ingganna kullemu anna untabaanni to mase-mase allinna. Aka maka' umpateem, iya la muampuammoko too kulle yabo suhuga. Puhai too, iya sulengko pole' untuhu'ä'.”
Sapo' nahingnginna indo tula' ia too, tä' deem pada samasussa penabanna aka mesa to sugi'.
Naitanna Puang Yesus tä' deem pada samasussa penabanna, iya ma'kadam naua: “Tä' deem pada samapahhi' to buda kullena la mendadi umma'na Puang Allataala illaam kapahentaanna.
Aka madomi' leko'um ia mesa unta muola tama tottä'na dahum, anna la mesa to makaka la mentama kapahentaanna Puang Allataala.”
Ingganna tau to uhhingngi tula'na Puang Yesus sangngim ma'kada naua: “Maka' susi, iya menna bäbä hi umbai' la mala dipasalama'?”
Iya natimba'um Puang Yesus naua: “Nakapusa'i ia hupatau diona to la mala dipasalama', sapo' tä' Ia nakapusa'i Puang Allataala.”
Iya ma'kadam Petrus naua: “Kitampeammi kami' dapo'ki aka kituhu'ko!”

Natimba' Puang Yesus naua: “Kutulasangkoa', setongam-tonganna menna-menna untampeam banuanna, battu haka bainena, solasubunna haka, tomatuanna haka, battu haka änä'na aka manuhu' lako kapahentaanna Puang Allataala,
tau ia too la dibala'iam tiluppi'-luppi' illaam inde lino. Anna illaam wattu la sule la untahima katuboam sule lako salako-lakona.”
Kapentallunna Puang Yesus untula' diona la kamateanna

Iya untambaim indo sapulo dua passikolanna Puang Yesus anna ia mandi napa'tula'i naua: “Inde tentomai la längämmakia' Yerusalem, anna ingganna indo to puha nasuha' ingganna nabi diona Kao to disangai Änä' Mentolino tä' mala tala sule lako.
Aka la nabehoä' lako to tamuissam Puang Allataala anna la natelleä' anna natunai. La nasitikkudu-kuduiä' anna nadahha lambi' napateiä'.
Sapo' illaam allo katallunna la dipatibangonnä' sule.”
Tula' ia too tä' natama akkalanna passikolanna aka tibunipi kalembasanna, nasuhum tä' naissam tungka batunna indo tula'na.
Puang Yesus umpabono' to buta
Tappana la landa' kale Puang Yesus lako kota Yerikho, iya deemmi mesa to buta muokko' dio bihim lalam kapelau-lau.
Tappana uhhingngi indo tau buda liu dio ampe'na, iya mekutanam naua: “Aka hia anna budai tau?”
Natimba'im indo tau buda naua: “Liu Puang Yesus indo to Nazaret.”
Iya metambam indo to buta naua: “O Yesus, peampoanna tomahaja Daud, kamaseiä' kao!”
Sapo' nakuapai hi indo to mendiolo naua: “Pengkamma'ko!” Sapo' tuttuam napekasallei mandi metamba naua: “O peampoanna Daud, kamaseiä' kao!”
Tappa tohho siaham Puang Yesus anna ussuai tau lao untette indo to buta napasola sule. Tappana sule, nakutanaim
naua: “Aka umpohäe la kupogausangko?” Natimba'um naua: “O Tuam, maelo' punalaä' duka' la paita.”
Iya ma'kadam Puang Yesus naua: “Paitangko! Bono'ungko aka ungkatappa'iä'.”
Iya paita siahanni lambi' untuhu' Puang Yesus napasindum umpa'kasallei Puang Allataala. Tappana naita tau buda bono'um indo to buta, sangngim umpa'kasallei duka' Puang Allataala.

footnotes.text: peampoanna tomahaja Daud: Indo anna ma'kadai indo to buta muuaam Puang Yesus: O peampoanna tomahaja Daud, indo kada ia too naissam asam to Yahudi napekalembasam naua: Mesias battu diua To nalanti' Puang Allataala napa'kadai. Aka indo to Yahudi umpemmitai liu Mesias pessubunna Daud la sule umpabono' ingganna to masaki anna la ma'pahenta umba susi tomahaja Daud ma'pahenta yolona (Puj. 89:3-37; Yes. 35:5-6).
